newsitem.title: CHINA: China names HK handover day as official holiday.
newsitem.headline: China names HK handover day as official holiday.

text.p: China named July 1, 1997, the day it will take back sovereignty of the British colony of Hong Kong, as an annual official holiday for the region, the Xinhua news agency said.

China's October 1 National Day, anniversary of the date in 1949 when Chairman Mao Zedong proclaimed communist rule over China, as well as July 1 and July 2 would become public holidays in Hong Kong, Xinhua said late on Thursday, quoting a decision by the chairman of Beijing's Preparatory Committee for arranging Hong Kong's new government.
It did not say which other existing Hong Kong public holidays would be retained.
